kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Likely from Greek γαρίδες (garídes, “shrimps”), from Ancient Greek κᾱρῖδες (kārîdes, “shrimps”), possibly influenced by the Arabic root ق ر د س (q r d s) or taken as the diminutive of قُرْدُوس (qurdūs), a rare derivation of قُرْد (qurd, “tick”).
s: ق ر د س (q r d s)
